name: Extract readable text from a document
description: The readable text of a PDF or Office document (docx, xlsx, pptx, and legacy doc, xls, ppt) supplied as bytes, with pages or slides marked, an optional page range and a character cap. For a file on a root or drive use file:read, vault:read or dlfs:read with mode 'extract' instead — same result, with the read's own authorisation. No OCR: a scanned PDF is reported as such.

filename.description: Its file name — the extension selects the parser when mime is not given

mime.description: Its MIME type, when known; otherwise detected from the name and content

pages.description: A page (or slide) number, a range like "3-5", or {first, last} — 1-based, inclusive. Applies to paged formats (pdf, pptx, ppt).

maxChars.description: Cap on the returned text; the module's configured default applies when omitted. 'truncated' reports when the cap cut, and 'lastPage' how far it got.

text.description: The readable text; pages or slides are marked '--- page N ---'

truncated.description: True when the character cap cut the text

pages.description: Page or slide count, for paged formats

firstPage.description: First page covered, for paged formats

lastPage.description: Last page covered — the page the cap cut into, when it did

meta.description: title, author, created (epoch millis) when the document carries them; sheets for workbooks; scanned: true with a note when a paged document has no usable text layer
